description: Challenge direct multi-filter game list navigations from AS45102
expression:
http.host eq "viprpg.org" and
http.request.method eq "GET" and
http.request.uri.path eq "/games" and
ip.src.asnum eq 45102 and
not any(http.request.uri.args.names[*] eq "page") and
not any(http.request.headers.names[*] in {"cookie" "referer"}) and
http.request.headers["sec-fetch-site"][0] eq "none" and
http.request.headers["sec-fetch-mode"][0] eq "navigate" and
http.request.headers["sec-fetch-dest"][0] eq "document" and
(
  (any(http.request.uri.args["duration"][*] ne "") and any(http.request.uri.args["genre"][*] ne "") and any(http.request.uri.args["language"][*] ne "")) or
  (any(http.request.uri.args["duration"][*] ne "") and any(http.request.uri.args["genre"][*] ne "") and any(http.request.uri.args["original"][*] ne "")) or
  (any(http.request.uri.args["duration"][*] ne "") and any(http.request.uri.args["genre"][*] ne "") and any(http.request.uri.args["sort"][*] ne "")) or
  (any(http.request.uri.args["duration"][*] ne "") and any(http.request.uri.args["genre"][*] ne "") and any(http.request.uri.args["uploader"][*] ne "")) or
